( often in pl ) area of land covered with trees, hutan kecil: there is a narrow path through the ~, ada sebuah lorong sempit merentasi hutan kecil itu; the deer took refuge in the ~s, rusa itu melarikan diri ke dlm hutan kecil; the children got lost in the ~s, budak-budak itu sesat dlm hutan kecil; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
